name: pickup_type_get_by_index_pure
description: PickupType::GetByIndex_Pure returns the pickup type table entry when the index is below 40 and returns null for index 40 or greater; like the original helper, it does not perform a lower-bound check.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41db40 validates the fastcall index argument, signed compare against 40, null return for index >= 40, and PickupType-size table address calculation for accepted indices.
The native pickup leaf smoke verifies the last valid entry and the upper-bound null case for PickupType::GetByIndex_Pure, alongside the stricter checked GetByIndex helper.
